| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/gds/gdsserver](gds-gdsserver.md) | Package gdsserver makes a server.Server a Global Discovery Server (GDS) by the pull model of OPC UA Part 12 (v1.05): the Directory object with the application directory (§6: RegisterApplication, UpdateApplication, UnregisterApplication, FindApplications, GetApplication, QueryApplications, QueryServers) and certificate management (§7.9: StartSigningRequest, StartNewKeyPairRequest, FinishRequest, RevokeCertificate, GetCertificateGroups, GetCertificates, GetTrustList, GetCertificateStatus, CheckRevocationStatus) with the TrustLists of its certificate groups. |

| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/jsonmsg](pubsub-jsonmsg.md) | Package jsonmsg implements the JSON message mapping of OPC UA PubSub (Part 14 §7.2.5): NetworkMessages and DataSetMessages ("ua-data"), DataSetMetaData messages ("ua-metadata"), status messages ("ua-status") and the messages of PubSub Actions ("ua-action-request", "ua-action-response", "ua-action-metadata", "ua-action-responder"). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/message](pubsub-message.md) | Package message is the encoding-independent model of OPC UA PubSub messages (Part 14 §7.2): NetworkMessages that carry DataSetMessages, and the DataSetMetaData that describes them. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/remote](pubsub-remote.md) | Package remote configures the PubSub of an OPC UA server through the methods of its PublishSubscribe information model (Part 14 §9): AddConnection, AddWriterGroup, AddDataSetWriter, AddReaderGroup, AddDataSetReader, AddPublishedDataItems, their Remove counterparts and the Enable and Disable methods of the PubSubStatus objects. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/security](pubsub-security.md) | Package security implements the message security of OPC UA PubSub (Part 14 §5.4.3, §7.2.2.2.6): the symmetric security policies PubSub-Aes128-CTR and PubSub-Aes256-CTR, the keys of SecurityGroups and their rotation, and the Security Key Service (SKS) that distributes them (GetSecurityKeys, Part 14 §8.3.2). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/sks](pubsub-sks.md) | Package sks is the client side of the OPC UA PubSub Security Key Service (Part 14 §8): GetSecurityKeys and SetSecurityKeys calls, a KeySource that pulls the keys of a SecurityGroup from an SKS and keeps them fresh, and a helper that pushes the keys of a local KeyService to a Publisher or Subscriber. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/transport](pubsub-transport.md) | Package transport is the transport layer of OPC UA PubSub (Part 14 §7.3): it moves encoded NetworkMessages between publishers and subscribers. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/transport/amqp](pubsub-transport-amqp.md) | Package amqp is the AMQP transport of OPC UA PubSub (Part 14 §7.3.4 and Annex B.3): NetworkMessages (UADP or JSON) as AMQP 1.0 messages on a broker. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/transport/eth](pubsub-transport-eth.md) | Package eth is the Ethernet transport of OPC UA PubSub (Part 14 §7.3.3, transport profile pubsub-eth-uadp): UADP NetworkMessages as the payload of Ethernet II frames with EtherType 0xB62C, without IP and UDP headers. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/transport/mqtt](pubsub-transport-mqtt.md) | Package mqtt is the MQTT transport of OPC UA PubSub (Part 14 §7.3.4 in 1.05.06, §7.3.5 in earlier 1.05 editions): NetworkMessages (UADP or JSON) as MQTT 3.1.1 or MQTT 5.0 messages on a broker. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/transport/udp](pubsub-transport-udp.md) | Package udp is the UDP transport of OPC UA PubSub (Part 14 §7.3.2): UADP NetworkMessages in UDP datagrams, unicast or multicast, IPv4 or IPv6. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/pubsub/uadp](pubsub-uadp.md) | Package uadp implements the UADP message mapping of OPC UA PubSub (Part 14 §7.2.2 in 1.04, §7.2.4 in 1.05): the binary encoding of NetworkMessages and DataSetMessages, including the message security of the security header. |
